findings.title: Payment Approval Does Not Create Sales Transactions
findings.description: The design states payment approval creates sales_transactions records, but the actual payments.service.ts approve method only updates status and sends email. Approved payments will not appear in transaction history.
findings.fix: Modify payments.service.ts approve method to inject TransactionsService and create a sales_transaction record after approval. Add transaction creation code to Section 3.2.2.

findings.title: Ambiguous Pending Transaction Storage
findings.description: The design presents two conflicting approaches for storing pending transactions (payment_requests vs sales_transactions.status='Pending') and is inconsistent throughout.
findings.fix: Remove Option 2 entirely. State definitively that all pending transactions use payment_requests ONLY. Update Section 4.2.1 to remove references to GET /transactions?status=Pending.

findings.title: Missing source Field Implementation Details
findings.description: The design says to add source field but does not specify column type, nullable, default value, enum values, or index requirements.
findings.fix: Replace entity modification with complete column definition including enum ['warehouse', 'shop'], nullable: true, default: 'warehouse', and @Index(). Update DTO with enum validation.

findings.title: Customer Balance Update Mechanism Unspecified
findings.description: The design assumes backend automatically updates customer_balances table but provides no implementation details or verification. Unclear if balance is stored, calculated, or updated by trigger.
findings.fix: Specify exact mechanism: either add balance update code to payment approval workflow, or document that balances are calculated on-the-fly and remove storage references.

findings.title: Refund Approval Workflow Inconsistent
findings.description: Refund approval workflow creates two transactions (Refund and Credit) for a single refund. Unclear if these are separate records or the same record. Also unclear when each is created.
findings.fix: Clarify that refund approval creates ONE sales_transactions record with transactionType='Refund' that handles both inventory return and customer credit. Remove or clarify step 4 distinction between store credit vs cash refund.

findings.title: Warehouse Value Calculation Endpoint Missing
findings.description: Design requires client-side calculation of warehouse value by fetching all items (1000+) and summing. This is slow and inefficient. No backend aggregation endpoint specified.
findings.fix: Add GET /items/statistics/warehouse-value endpoint with backend aggregation query, OR explicitly state client-side calculation limit (e.g., acceptable for up to 1000 items).

findings.title: Pagination and Filtering Incomplete
findings.description: Design says to add source filtering to payments endpoints but does not specify how findByStatus method accepts source param. Frontend code shows source in query params but implementation is missing.
findings.fix: Add complete implementation: modify PaymentsController.findByStatus to accept source query param, and modify PaymentsService.findByStatus method signature and where clause to filter by source.

findings.title: API Response Shape Not Specified
findings.description: Section 3.4 states responses should be wrapped in {success: true, data: {...}} but frontend code examples assume unwrapped responses like {count: number}. Design contradicts itself.
findings.fix: Clarify in Section 3.4 that successful responses return unwrapped data payloads (no success wrapper), and only error responses include {success: false}. Update all frontend code examples.

findings.title: Expenses Module Entity Missing Soft Delete
findings.description: All other backend entities support soft delete but expenses entity does not include deletedAt field. Design inconsistently recommends hard delete for expenses.
findings.fix: Add deletedAt field and @Index to expenses entity. Change recommendation to use soft delete for consistency with other entities.

findings.title: Missing Idempotency for Payment Approval
findings.description: Concurrent approvals risk mitigation is vague. Without idempotency check, duplicate transactions could be created or customer balance updated twice.
findings.fix: Add idempotency check to approval implementation: before creating sales_transaction, check if one already exists with referenceId=payment.id. If exists, return existing transaction.

findings.title: Email Service Dependency Not Declared
findings.description: Payments module sends email notifications on approval, but design does not specify if expenses module should also send emails or import EmailModule.
findings.fix: Add to Section 3.1: ExpensesModule does NOT send email notifications. Or if needed, specify EmailModule import and notification triggers.

findings.title: No Specification for Multi-Bank Payment Storage
findings.description: Design assumes multi-bank payments store bankNumber in notes field (unstructured), but does not specify how splits are related, approved as group, or queried.
findings.fix: Either remove multi-bank payments from MVP scope, OR add proper schema with paymentGroupId, splitNumber, totalSplits fields and specify group approval logic.
